name: zvid_query_device_video_memory_bytes
description: zVid::QueryDeviceVideoMemoryBytes returns DirectDraw video-memory totals and free bytes either from the current provider query or from cached hardware API device records.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw memory-query/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9950 validates the software-renderer zero/return-zero path, the deviceIndexOrMinus1 == -1 IDirectDraw2::GetAvailableVidMem call through vtable slot 0x5c with DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY, the failure zeroing path, the selected-device texture reservation subtraction on success, and cached record loads at offsets 0x94, 0x98, and 0x9c with 0x6ec stride.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a9950 has no warnings and matches the implemented provider and cached-table branches.

The native smoke verifies software-renderer zeroing, DirectDraw provider success and failure behavior, DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY dispatch, selected texture-memory subtraction, cached record free-byte subtraction, and the shared-memory reserve branch. The report-error smoke verifies the installed device-memory query dispatch remains callable by DirectDraw error reporting.
